name: Unused disable directive
description: Flags unknown @disable/@disable-file rule ids and directives that suppress no diagnostic. Disabled by default.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, each rule id in an `@disable`/`@disable-file` comment that is unknown or does not suppress a diagnostic from that rule (on its line for `@disable`, anywhere in the file for `@disable-file`). A bare `@disable` is flagged when its line has no diagnostics to suppress; a bare `@disable-file` is flagged when the whole file has none. Disabled by default; opt in with `rules.unused_disable`. Automatically fixable: the fix drops unused rule ids from the directive, or the whole directive when none of its ids suppress a diagnostic.
